race.comment: MAKAMAE (7) was well below her best when finishing down the track as the favourite at this venue last start when racing too keenly, but she is far better than that effort suggests, so give her a chance to make amends. DOUBLE WHAMMY (6) has been not too bad in 3 starts since winning here by a nose at the end of May. Stick with him. CHASSAGNE (2) drops in class second up, and she has been a winner in that state in the past. A handy gate, and Ben Thompson in the saddle all help her, and she can be a sharp improver off a modest effort fresh. BIG TICKET BOY (4) has the pace to lead this field, and though he is out of form, he can turn it all around with one of his better efforts. Include in all top 4 combos to be safe.
